verdict.rationale: LangGraph's GitHub docs explicitly claim LangSmith-based debugging with 'visualization tools that trace execution paths, capture state transitions, and provide detailed runtime metrics,' which is exactly the trace-every-call observability UI story. However, the evidence pack lacks first-party LangSmith UI documentation details (screenshots, trace schema, per-tool-call breakdown) and independent hands-on confirmation that all LLM calls/tool invocations are captured; community comments only tangentially mention debugging UI for graph structure. Missing for 10: detailed LangSmith tracing docs, independent/hands-on verification of full LLM+tool call visibility.
